fallen_sects.name: Hàn Giang Môn
fallen_sects.cause: conquered by Băng Tâm in the War of the Frost Coast

events.text: Fishers and sea hunters of the frost coast found Trạc Anh Đài, where they wash their hat strings in the clear water.

residents.name: Đoàn Thanh Lãng
residents.role: Head of Trạc Anh Đài, fishers and sea hunters of the frost coast

seat_of.name: Trạc Anh Đài
seat_of.gloss: Terrace Where the Hat Strings Are Washed
seat_of.craft: fishers and sea hunters of the frost coast
seat_of.note: Khuất Nguyên, Ngư Phủ: the fisherman's song, when the water is clear, wash your hat strings in it

places.name: Liên Giang Thành
places.gloss: City Where the Rain Meets the River
places.note: Vương Xương Linh: hàn vũ liên giang dạ nhập Ngô (cold rain joins the river by night), the first line of the Băng Tâm poem

events.text: Hàn Giang Môn founds Liên Giang Thành where the cold rain joins the river.
After the Frost Coast falls, Hàn Giang's fishers keep fishing the cold river under Băng Tâm's flag and pay their tax in ice-fish.
Đoàn Thanh Lãng is born in Liên Giang Thành during a cold rain that joins the river by night.

places.name: Tống Khách Thị
places.note: Vương Xương Linh: bình minh tống khách (at dawn I see my guest off), the Băng Tâm poem

events.text: A traveller is seen off at dawn from Tống Khách Thị and never returns; the market still pours a farewell cup for him each year.
After his duel, Tư Không Hạc Niên settles in Tống Khách Thị and teaches no one.

residents.name: Tư Không Hạc Niên
residents.role: A wandering sword sage (age 500), bound to no sect

events.text: Băng Tâm Các founds Mộc Lan Thành on the frost coast.
Hunters bring a white bear out of Vô Tung Lâm alive and sell it in Mộc Lan Thành to a buyer from Thiên Bảo Trai.
The cock crows at Kê Minh even in the dark of winter; the town keeps the cock as its emblem.
The woodcutters' paths into Vô Tung Lâm vanish under the snow every night; only the people of Tiều Lộ Thôn can find them again.
Lâm Ẩn Thôn shelters a hermit who teaches the village children to read tracks in the snow.
Reed flowers cover the marsh at Lô Hoa Thôn like snow in summer.

places.name: Băng Lăng Khoáng
places.note: Shafts hung with ice in the frost land of Hàn Sương Châu.

events.text: Băng Tâm opens Băng Lăng Khoáng, a shaft hung with ice that never melts.

places.name: Sương Diễm Sơn
places.note: Fire under the frost of the north-east peninsula

events.text: Sương Diễm Sơn breathes fire under the frost for a week; the people of Mộc Lan Thành sleep on the beach.

places.name: Phiến Băng Hồ
places.gloss: Lake of the Piece of Ice
places.note: Vương Xương Linh: nhất phiến băng tâm (one piece of ice heart); beside Băng Tâm Các

events.text: Phiến Băng Hồ freezes as clear as glass; Băng Tâm disciples meditate on it and see their own hearts.

places.name: Vô Tung Lâm
places.note: Liễu Tông Nguyên, Giang Tuyết: vạn kính nhân tung diệt (on ten thousand paths, no human trace)

places.name: Hàn Giang Môn
places.note: The fishers' sect of the frost coast, conquered by Băng Tâm.

events.text: Liễu Thoa Lạp founds Hàn Giang Môn on the frost coast, a sect of fishers who cultivate alone in the snow on the cold river.
Hàn Giang's fishers cut holes in the river ice and sit cultivating in the snow beside them for days without moving.
Hàn Giang Môn falls with its last head Liễu Cô Chu; Hàn Sương Châu and Liên Giang Thành pass to Băng Tâm Các.

places.name: Tuyết Lang Nguyên
places.note: Tundra of Hàn Sương Châu where the snow wolves run in packs.

places.name: Noãn Ngọc Tuyền
places.note: A warm spring in the frost land of Hàn Sương Châu, its stones warm to the touch.

regions.name: Cô Vụ Đảo
regions.gloss: Isle of the Lone Wild Duck
regions.image: Vương Bột: lạc hà dữ cô vụ tề phi, the same line as Lạc Hà Tông

holder.name: Lạc Hà Tông
holder.gloss: Sect of the Drifting Sunset Clouds

events.text: Strangers far from home, meeting on the island like duckweed on water, found Bình Thủy Môn.
Bùi Phiêu Bình becomes head of Bình Thủy Môn; under him the strait crossing runs every day of the year.

residents.name: Bùi Phiêu Bình
residents.role: Head of Bình Thủy Môn, sea trade, ships and the strait crossing

seat_of.name: Bình Thủy Môn
seat_of.craft: sea trade, ships and the strait crossing
seat_of.note: Vương Bột: bình thủy tương phùng, tận thị tha hương chi khách (duckweed meets water: all here are strangers far from home)

places.name: Đàm Ảnh Thành
places.note: Vương Bột, Đằng Vương Các: nhàn vân đàm ảnh nhật du du (idle clouds and their reflections in the pool, day after day)

events.text: Cô Phàm Các builds Đàm Ảnh Thành, and below it the harbour of Bích Không Cảng, from which its sails vanish into the blue.
Đàm Ảnh Thành's still pool mirrors the clouds so clearly that painters come from the mainland to paint the sky upside down.
A Hóa Thần tribulation over the island sea kills the master of Đoạn Thương Hải; he survives it, blind, holding the Thương Tang Kính.
Blind after the tribulation, Đoạn Thương Hải settles in Đàm Ảnh Thành and listens to the pool instead of looking at it.

residents.name: Đoạn Thương Hải
residents.role: The only man to survive a Hóa Thần tribulation that killed his master (age 480); blind since, lives by the island sea

places.name: Tương Phùng Thị
places.note: Vương Bột: bình thủy tương phùng (duckweed and water meet by chance); beside Bình Thủy Môn

events.text: A market of chance meetings grows beside Bình Thủy Môn; it is called Tương Phùng Thị.
The first mainland traders name the red cliffs of the island's east coast Xích Ngạn.
Sea swallows nest so thickly under the eaves of Hải Yến Trấn that its people sell the nests to alchemists.
Lạc Hà Tông founds Triều Âm Thành on the western shore of Cô Vụ Đảo.
Islanders gather shells on the white beach of Bối Sa to trade as coins on the mainland.
Wave Rock at Lãng Thạch Thôn splits in a storm, and a sea cave full of old Cô Phàm charts is found inside.
Willows planted on the dunes at Dương Liễu Thôn hold the island's sand against the storms.
On the sunny sands of Tình Sa a stranded whale lives for three days; the island gives it back to the sea.
The moon-shaped cove at Nguyệt Loan shelters the island's fishing fleet from the great storm of 870.

places.name: Bích Không Cảng
places.note: Lý Bạch: the lone sail vanishes into the blue sky. Cô Phàm's harbour, emptied when the fleet was lost.

events.text: Giang Bích Không makes the Viễn Ảnh Châm, a needle that always points to the last ship to leave port.
A year after the fleet is lost, the widows of Bích Không Cảng leave the harbour; the empty quays face the blue.

places.name: Vụ Báo Lâm
places.note: Jungle of Cô Vụ Đảo, the lonely misty island, where leopards hunt in the mist.

regions.name: Trường Thiên Nguyên
regions.image: Vương Bột: thu thủy cộng trường thiên nhất sắc

holder.name: Lạc Hà Tông
holder.gloss: Sect of the Drifting Sunset Clouds

events.text: Herders of the open plain found Mục Vân Trang to raise spirit horses that run like clouds.
Mục Vân Trang's horses win every race at the Lạc Hà festival; Kim Vạn Lý bets on them and loses anyway.

residents.name: Khấu Mục Vân
residents.role: Head of Mục Vân Trang, spirit horses and herd beasts of the open plain

seat_of.name: Mục Vân Trang
seat_of.craft: spirit horses and herd beasts of the open plain
seat_of.note: Herding clouds under the endless sky of Trường Thiên Nguyên

places.name: Nhạn Thanh Thành
places.gloss: City of the Wild Geese's Cry
places.note: Vương Bột: nhạn trận kinh hàn (the wild geese in formation, startled by the cold)

events.text: Lạc Hà Tông founds Nhạn Thanh Thành on the western plain, where the wild geese fly in formation.
Kim Vạn Lý buys the wool of the whole plain in one season and becomes the richest merchant of the west.
Wild geese fly so low over Nhạn Thanh Thành in a cold year that archers shoot them from the walls; the city forbids it ever after.

residents.name: Kim Vạn Lý
residents.role: The richest merchant of the western plains (age 350)

events.text: The green fields around Thanh Điền stretch so far that its farmers ride to their work.
Khấu Mục Vân is born in Thanh Điền; a spirit foal is born the same night and will let no one else ride it.
Lạc Hà Tông founds Thảo Đường Thành among the farms of the western plain.
Lạc Hà's rule brings fishing weirs to the plain's rivers; Ngư Lương Trấn grows around the largest.
The gardens and fields of Điền Viên feed the scholars of Nhạn Thanh Thành, who retire there to farm.
Swallows return to the same farm every spring for a hundred years; the village becomes Yến Quy.
A ford on the plain's widest river becomes Chu Tân Thôn.
A reed harbour at Lô Cảng shelters the coast boats; Lạc Hà builds its western watch there.
Salt pans dug at Diêm Điền on the west coast make the continent's first sea salt.

places.name: Phù Chử Đảo
places.note: Vương Bột: hạc đinh phù chử (crane shoals and wild-duck isles)

events.text: Wild ducks crowd the isle of Phù Chử so thickly that boats must wait for them to move.

places.name: Tịch Chiếu Đảo
places.note: The westernmost island, last to see the sunset of Lạc Hà

events.text: The westernmost island, Tịch Chiếu, is the last land to see the sunset; Lạc Hà's elders go there to die.

regions.name: Thu Thủy Loan
regions.image: The same line: autumn water one colour with the endless sky

holder.name: Lạc Hà Tông
holder.gloss: Sect of the Drifting Sunset Clouds

events.text: Thiên Bảo Trai is founded beside the bay as a refiners' workshop; its sign says the riches of the land are heaven's treasures.
Phan Vật Hoa becomes mistress of Thiên Bảo Trai and holds a treasure auction every season.

residents.name: Phan Vật Hoa
residents.role: Mistress of Thiên Bảo Trai, artifact refining and the treasure market

seat_of.name: Thiên Bảo Trai
seat_of.craft: artifact refining and a treasure market
seat_of.note: Vương Bột: vật hoa thiên bảo (the riches of the land are the treasures of heaven)

places.name: Tử Điện Thành
places.note: Vương Bột: tử điện thanh sương, Vương tướng quân chi vũ khố (the purple-lightning and blue-frost swords of General Vương's armoury)

events.text: Lạc Anh Phái founds a city on the bay side of the Petal Shore; it will bear another name before it bears its last.
The Pivot's judgement divides the Petal Shore, the bay to Lạc Hà and the forest to Thính Vũ; Lạc Hà renames the bay city Tử Điện Thành, for its armoury.

places.name: Vật Hoa Thị
places.note: Vương Bột: vật hoa thiên bảo (the riches of the land are heaven's treasures); beside Thiên Bảo Trai

events.text: A market for the land's riches grows beside Thiên Bảo Trai; it is called Vật Hoa Thị.
A year after Kim Cốc burns, its merchants beg in Vật Hoa Thị; Thiên Bảo Trai hires the ones who can still count.
Lạc Đan Thanh buys the Đào Nguyên Đồ at Vật Hoa Thị for a pill no one else could make.
Lạc Đan Thanh sets up his pill stall in Vật Hoa Thị and charges whatever he likes.

residents.name: Lạc Đan Thanh
residents.role: A famous alchemist who sells his pills in the market (age 300)

events.text: Willows planted on the bank at Liễu Ngạn hold the river where it floods.
A gentle sea breeze keeps Hòa Phong Trấn free of fever in the year of the southern plague.
Ngũ Cốc Thành grows rich on the trade Kim Cốc lost.
The brooks at Khê Đầu and Khê Thanh run so clear that Thiên Bảo Trai washes its finest refinings in them.
The Sea Gate at Hải Môn Thôn is a rock arch the tide runs through twice a day.
Refugees from Vô Định Thành found Tân Khẩu Thôn at the harbour mouth and never speak of the plain.

places.name: Xích Kim Khoáng
places.note: Gold the colour of Lạc Hà's sunset, for Thiên Bảo Trai's treasure market.

events.text: Red gold is found at Xích Kim; Thiên Bảo Trai buys the mine before Lạc Hà's stewards hear of it.

places.name: Trường Hà Mạch
places.note: Vương Duy: trường hà lạc nhật viên, the long river and the round setting sun. On the border with Thính Vũ.

events.text: Lạc Hà finds the Long River vein on its new border with Thính Vũ and names it Trường Hà Mạch.

places.name: Kim Cốc Thành
places.note: Kim Cốc Viên's merchant city, burned in the crash of 1003.

events.text: Merchants of Thu Thủy Loan found Kim Cốc Viên, a garden of trade under Lạc Hà Tông, and build Kim Cốc Thành around it.
Kim Cốc Viên collapses in a market crash and a great fire; Kim Cốc Thành burns, and the pearl Lục Châu is lost in the ashes.

places.name: Hồng Vũ Thành
places.note: Lý Hạ: peach petals falling like red rain. Lạc Anh's city on the Petal Shore, burned in the war over its land.

events.text: Đào Tân Phân forges the twin swords Phi Hồng and Tàn Hồng from one peach branch hardened by a thousand springs, and decrees that whoever holds both leads the school.
Lạc Anh Phái builds Hồng Vũ Thành on the Petal Shore.
Hồng Vũ Thành burns in the fighting; its petals and its ashes fall together like red rain.
Ghost lights are seen on the ruins of Hồng Vũ Thành every spring when the peach trees bloom.

places.name: Vô Định Thành
places.gloss: City of the Vô Định River
places.note: Trần Đào: the bones by the Vô Định river that wives still dream of. Burned in the battle of 803 and left to the miasma.

events.text: Lạc Hà Tông builds Vô Định Thành on the river where three lands meet.
Vô Định Thành burns in the battle on the plain, and the miasma takes what is left; its dead are still dreamed of in the river towns.
Children of Tân Khẩu dare each other to touch the edge of the miasma by Vô Định Thành; one doesn't come back.

places.name: Thiên Chu Lâm
places.note: Jungle of Thu Thủy Loan webbed by poison spiders.
